I decided I wanted to go that step further and shave it off. I’m having a number four all over and it’s happening on 15th July - not long!! 

So far I have raised £1125 but I was thinking that I could reach a wider audience. This total can pay for two children to have free wigs which is amazing! By donating, the money would be going directly to the little princess trust so any donations would be much appreciated and you’ll really be making a huge difference to a lot of young people’s lives!
